checks.command: pnpm --dir web exec tsc -b && pnpm --dir web lint

summary: Added `first_played` to the Deck model (between last_played and first_seen), rewrote /api/decks in src/sensei_top/api/routes/meta.py to use a `first_played` CTE (MIN(matches.started_at) grouped by deck_id joined through v_match_deck), LEFT JOIN it onto v_deck_summary, and filter `WHERE s.matches_played > 0` so zero-match MTGO decks are dropped while the ORDER BY is unchanged. Regenerated web/src/types/api.ts with `pnpm --dir web gen:types` (web/openapi.json is gitignored). Updated versionDays in web/src/lib/deckOverview.ts to take first_played/first_seen/last_played and start from `deck.first_played ?? deck.first_seen`, with an updated doc comment. All five check commands pass: pytest 183 passed, ruff clean, gen:types clean, vitest 496 passed, tsc + oxlint clean. No test files changed.
concerns: The CTE reads MIN over all matches per deck (both sources); confirm v_match_deck's grain makes this the intended earliest match start.
v_deck_summary.matches_played > 0 is the sole zero-match filter; check in-progress matches are counted there as tests expect.
